format_mismatches: Missing timestamp fields in detection output
Bounding box coordinate format not explicitly defined or normalized for downstream consumption
Class labels remapped but lack explicit schema validation against auto_labeler expectations

issues.description: No timestamp fields attached to detection outputs, breaking temporal synchronization required by the Human-Aware obstacle pipeline.
Bounding box format (pixel vs normalized, xyxy vs xywh) is not explicitly standardized in the return dictionary structure due to code truncation and missing post-processing serialization logic.
Class label remapping via CLASS_REMAP may conflict with auto_labeler's expected semantic vocabulary if downstream expects raw COCO IDs or different ontology naming conventions.
